styleLock.direction: soft pastel baby-care ecommerce detail page
styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white studio base with soft cream-pink infographic bands and scalloped pink awning accents
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright airy high-key soft daylight; front-top soft key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh contrast
styleLock.surfaceSystem: smooth matte white tabletop; coarse burlap texture used only in material-origin scenes
styleLock.typography: rounded friendly sans-serif headlines with small letter-spaced light-grey English caption lines; no serif, no handwriting, no cartoon fonts

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft pastel baby-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF background, cream-pink #FBE4E9 panel tint, warm grey #4A4A4A text, and rose-pink #F48CA5 accent; warm tone; rounded friendly sans-serif headlines with small letter-spaced warm-grey #4A4A4A English caption lines; clean white studio backgrounds with soft pink infographic bands and scalloped pink awning accents; bright airy high-key soft daylight, gentle soft shadows; thin-line circular outline icons in rose pink on white rounded cards; product always presented as a neatly folded soft textile stack with stable centered scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Centered slight 3/4 eye-level view of {product} arranged as a neatly folded soft textile stack, full product visible, nothing clipped. provenance.notes: 源为 800×1200 详情页长图切成的 6 张相邻重叠切片，整体版面已拼合分析。主产品为婴儿六层泡泡纱浴巾，与源文件夹名「宝宝浴巾 (2)」一致。分类取 taxonomy 精确串：L1=母婴、L2=洗护（浴巾属婴儿洗护沐浴用品，虽可兼作盖毯/空调毯，主用途仍为洗护）。已剥离：品牌字标（DW 及中文字标）、『品质保障 100%』章的百分比数字、全部原文案（标题/副标/栏目名/规格值均改为 {callout}/{selling_point} 文案槽位由使用方填写）；未保留模特与证书。规格表与信任镜均不渲染真实数值，不编造认证与数据，规格值由使用方生成时填入。
